Input: the 8 Cell Ranger matrices for the run named by `GR0389_RUN`, `Data/sample_sheet.csv`.
Output: `Working/objects_<run>/global.rds`, figures in `Figures/<run>/`, tables in `Tables/<run>/`.
No cell type labels here, clusters only.

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = if (basename(getwd()) == "Analysis") normalizePath("..") else getwd())
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source(if (file.exists("_setup.R")) "_setup.R" else "Analysis/_setup.R")
```

## Load the 8 matrices

```{r load}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(scds); library(SingleCellExperiment) })
one_sample <- function(i) {
  m <- rename_loc_matrix(Read10X(mtx_path(ss$sample[i])), gene_map)
  o <- CreateSeuratObject(m, project = ss$sample[i], min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
  o <- RenameCells(o, add.cell.id = ss$sample[i])
  for (v in names(ss)) o[[v]] <- ss[[v]][i]
  o$percent.mt <- PercentageFeatureSet(o, features = gfind(o, mt_genes))
  o$percent.ribo <- PercentageFeatureSet(o, pattern = "^RP[SL]\\d+[A-Z]?$")
  o$percent.hb <- PercentageFeatureSet(o, features = gfind(o, c("HBZ", "HBQ1", "HBB", "HBA1", "HBA2", "HBE1")))
  o$doublet_score <- cxds_bcds_hybrid(SingleCellExperiment(list(counts = GetAssayData(o, layer = "counts"))))$hybrid_score
  o$doublet <- ifelse(rank(-o$doublet_score) <= round(.008 * ncol(o)^2 / 1000), "doublet", "singlet")
  o
}
objs <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(ss)), one_sample)
obj <- JoinLayers(merge(objs[[1]], objs[-1]))
rm(objs)
obj$sample <- factor(obj$sample, levels = ss$sample)
obj$label <- labs_of(obj$sample)
obj$timepoint <- factor(obj$timepoint, levels = tp_levels)
c(cells = ncol(obj), genes = nrow(obj))
```

## Quality control

```{r qc}
mt_max <- if (run == "v2_ncbi") 10 else 100
feat_max <- if (run == "v2_ncbi") 7000 else 5000
umi_max  <- if (run == "v2_ncbi") 45000 else 30000
qc_feats <- c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt", "percent.ribo", "doublet_score")
p_before <- VlnPlot(obj, qc_feats, group.by = "label", pt.size = 0, ncol = 5) & rot & labs(x = NULL)
ggsave(file.path(fig, "step00_01_qc_violin_before_filter.pdf"), p_before, width = 18, height = 5)
p_before
md <- obj@meta.data

if (run == "v2_ncbi") print(md |> group_by(sample) |> summarise(median_mt = round(median(percent.mt), 2), p95 = round(quantile(percent.mt, .95), 2), over_cut = sum(percent.mt > mt_max), pct_over = round(100 * mean(percent.mt > mt_max), 1)) |> as.data.frame())
keep <- md$nFeature_RNA >= 500 & md$nFeature_RNA <= feat_max & md$nCount_RNA <= umi_max & md$percent.mt <= mt_max & md$percent.ribo <= 50 & md$percent.hb <= 1 & md$doublet == "singlet"
obj <- subset(obj, cells = rownames(md)[keep])
p_after <- VlnPlot(obj, qc_feats, group.by = "label", pt.size = 0, ncol = 5) & rot & labs(x = NULL)
ggsave(file.path(fig, "step00_02_qc_violin_after_filter.pdf"), p_after, width = 18, height = 5)
p_after
qc <- data.frame(sample = md$sample, keep) |> group_by(sample) |> summarise(before = n(), after = sum(keep), pct_kept = round(100 * mean(keep), 1)) |> mutate(label = labs_of(sample), .after = sample)
write.csv(qc, file.path(tab, "step00_cells_per_sample.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
qc
```

## Normalise, variable genes, scale, PCA

```{r normalize}
obj[["RNA"]] <- split(obj[["RNA"]], f = obj$sample)
obj <- NormalizeData(obj, verbose = FALSE)
obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj, nfeatures = 2700, verbose = FALSE)
VariableFeatures(obj) <- head(drop_ig(VariableFeatures(obj)), 2500)

obj <- ScaleData(obj, verbose = FALSE)
obj <- RunPCA(obj, npcs = 50, verbose = FALSE)
p_elbow <- ElbowPlot(obj, ndims = 50)
ggsave(file.path(fig, "step00_03_pca_elbow.pdf"), p_elbow, width = 6, height = 4)
p_elbow
```

## Harmony integration and clustering

```{r integration}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(harmony))
obj <- IntegrateLayers(obj, method = HarmonyIntegration, orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "harmony", verbose = FALSE)
obj <- JoinLayers(obj)
obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30, verbose = FALSE)
obj <- FindClusters(obj, resolution = 1, verbose = FALSE)
obj <- RunUMAP(obj, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30, verbose = FALSE)
obj <- RunUMAP(obj, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30, reduction.name = "umap_unintegrated", verbose = FALSE)
obj$seurat_clusters <- obj$RNA_snn_res.1
Idents(obj) <- obj$seurat_clusters
p_unint <- DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap_unintegrated", group.by = "label", shuffle = TRUE, raster = TRUE) + ggtitle("Before integration") + NoLegend()
p_int <- DimPlot(obj, group.by = "label", shuffle = TRUE, raster = TRUE) + ggtitle("After integration")
p_batch <- (p_unint | p_int) & labs(x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2")
ggsave(file.path(fig, "step00_04_umap_before_after_integration.pdf"), p_batch, width = 13, height = 6)
p_batch
table(obj$seurat_clusters)
```

## Final UMAP

```{r umap}
p_cl <- DimPlot(obj, label = TRUE, label.size = 4, raster = TRUE) + NoLegend() + labs(x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2") + big
ggsave(file.path(fig, "step00_05_umap_clusters.pdf"), p_cl, width = 8, height = 7)
p_cl
p_split <- DimPlot(obj, split.by = "label", ncol = 4, raster = TRUE) + NoLegend() + labs(x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2")
ggsave(file.path(fig, "step00_06_umap_split_by_sample.pdf"), p_split, width = 16, height = 8)
p_split
saveRDS(obj, gfile)
c(cells = ncol(obj), clusters = nlevels(obj$seurat_clusters))
```
